notes.subject: זרזיר
notes.rationale: occurs only here; literally 'tightly-girt of loins' — rendered 'कमर-कसल', readings range from greyhound to fighting cock

notes.subject: אלקום
notes.rationale: unique word, read as 'non-rising' (no rising up against him) or as an Arabic loan 'army/host' (a king with his army)

notes.subject: זרזיר מתנים
notes.rationale: doubled זר root mimics the tightly-girded gait; the sound-picture is lost in translation

translation: कमर-कसल गोट, खासी बकरा, आउ राजा — जेकरा संग उठै के नञ होवऽ हइ।
